identity.name: Radio 2Go
identity.positioning: Digital-only Swiss AC radio from Aargau — mellow pop, gold, and easy listening, largely automated, targeting leisure listeners over 35

profile.description: Radio 2Go is a Swiss internet and DAB+ station based in Brugg, Aargau, broadcasting adult contemporary pop and gold tracks Switzerland-wide. Added a Liechtenstein edition (Jan 2025) with a morning show.
